shiftLock.slot: ELECTRONIC PRECISION SHIFT — column-mounted shift-by-wire lever (NOT a rotary dial or console selector). The lever is on the steering column. To shift to N with power: press and hold the side interlock button on the lever, push lever forward to first bump and release — 'N' illuminates red. DEAD BATTERY / NO POWER: restore 12V via jump pack (battery under hood). No mechanical cabin override exists — must have 12V to shift electronically.
steps: Turn ignition to ON.
Pry or slide the trim piece at the base of the electronic gear selector to expose the override slot.
Remove trim panel or cover if present — use a trim pry tool or your fingernail at the edge.
Insert a thin key or flathead into the exposed slot.
Press firmly inward and hold.
While holding, press the brake pedal.
Press the N button or move the electronic selector to Neutral.
Apply parking brake.
Connect jump pack to battery — under hood.
Once 12V restored: press and hold the side interlock button on the column-mounted shift lever, push lever forward to first bump, release — 'N' lights up.
No mechanical override exists — power MUST be restored before shifting.
TRANSFER CASE: must be in 2WD/2H before towing. With engine running, press 2WD button on dash or TC controls.
4WD: FLATBED preferred. 2WD: can lift from rear after confirming N.

tow.method: RWD/2WD: lift from rear — rear (drive) wheels in the air. 4WD: transfer case to 2H first, then lift from rear — rear (drive) wheels in the air. Wheel-lift max: 35 mph, 50 miles — flatbed preferred for longer distances.
notes: ELECTRONIC TRANSFER CASE: Requires 12V power to shift. If battery is dead, jump the battery FIRST, then shift TC to 2WD before disconnecting.
DEAD BATTERY FALLBACK: If TC cannot be shifted to 2WD, USE FLATBED. Do NOT tow with TC in 4WD/4H/4L — will destroy transfer case and driveline.
4WD DOLLY FALLBACK: If transfer case CANNOT be shifted to 2WD (dead battery, mechanical failure), either use flatbed OR wheel-lift with dollies on the opposite axle.

steps: Turn ignition to ON.
Pry or slide the trim piece at the base of the electronic gear selector to expose the override slot.
Remove trim panel or cover if present — use a trim pry tool or your fingernail at the edge.

Press firmly inward and hold.
While holding, press the brake pedal.
Press the N button or move the electronic selector to Neutral.
Apply parking brake and chock wheels — heavy vehicle.
Connect jump pack — under hood, driver side. Diesel: connect to positive terminal closest to firewall.

tow.method: RWD/2WD: lift from rear — rear (drive) wheels in the air. 4WD: transfer case to 2H first. Heavy-duty — use rated equipment. Wheel-lift max: 35 mph, 50 miles — flatbed preferred for longer distances.
notes: MANUAL TRANSFER CASE (floor lever): Vehicle must be STOPPED to shift. If lever is stiff, rock vehicle slightly in neutral while applying firm pressure.
ELECTRONIC TRANSFER CASE: Requires 12V power to shift. If battery is dead, jump the battery FIRST, then shift TC to 2WD before disconnecting.
DEAD BATTERY FALLBACK: If TC cannot be shifted to 2WD, USE FLATBED. Do NOT tow with TC in 4WD/4H/4L — will destroy transfer case and driveline.
HEAVY VEHICLE: Use properly rated wheel blocks, straps, and chains. Verify your equipment weight rating before attempting to load or lift.
DIESEL: Same shift-lock and tow procedures as gasoline variant. Heavier curb weight — account for extra weight in equipment ratings.
4WD DOLLY FALLBACK: If transfer case CANNOT be shifted to 2WD (dead battery, mechanical failure), either use flatbed OR wheel-lift with dollies on the opposite axle.

steps: FLATBED ONLY — AWD electric drivetrain. NEVER tow with wheels on ground.
12V auxiliary battery under hood — connect jump pack here for 12V systems only.
NEVER touch HV traction battery under floor or orange/yellow HV cables.
Once 12V restored, press brake, select N on electronic selector.
Extremely heavy (~9,000+ lbs) — CONFIRM tow truck rated for this weight before loading.
Crab Walk / 4-wheel steer: ensure feature is off and wheels are straight before loading on flatbed.

battery.location: 12V auxiliary battery under hood. HV Ultium traction battery under floor (~212 kWh) — NEVER touch orange/yellow HV cables. Extreme caution: HV system is extremely high voltage and high capacity.

alerts.notes: Built on Ultium EV platform. Tri-motor = 1,000 hp. Air suspension — set to Extract (raised) mode for flatbed loading if possible. Weight exceeds most flatbed capacity — confirm before dispatch.

meta.transmission: 4-speed automatic 4L60-E (5.7L V8) or 4L65-E (Denali 5.7L/6.5L diesel option)

shiftLock.slot: COLUMN SHIFTER: shift interlock slot on the STEERING COLUMN housing. Turn key to ON/ACC, insert flathead screwdriver into slot, press brake, move column lever to N.

steps: Apply parking brake.
Connect jump pack — under hood, driver side.
Turn key to ON, insert flathead into column slot, press brake, move lever to N.
TRANSFER CASE: manual floor lever — shift to 2WD/2H before road towing.
4WD: FLATBED preferred. 2WD: can lift from rear.

alerts.notes: GMT400 platform Yukon. 2-door 1992-1994, 4-door 1995+. Renamed from Jimmy Full-Size to Yukon in 1992. Column shift all trims.
